blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) aligns a language model to a general preference function by approximating the Nash equilibrium of a two-player preference game. Its practical variant, DNO-Prct, iterates on-policy sampling, LLM-based rating of the samples together with a teacher's gold response, large-margin preference-pair selection and a DPO-style contrastive update. We re-implement DNO-Prct independently and study it on two open-weight instruct models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, with GPT-4o or a larger open-weight model of the same family as the annotator. On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o as judge, three iterations raise the length-controlled (LC) win rate against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win rate. With same-family open-weight annotators, the runs retain 62% (Llama) and 82% (Mistral) of the LC gain achieved with GPT-4o as annotator, so the rating step does not require a proprietary model. In a separate ablation configuration, variants that remove the gold responses, remove the data look-back, or accept only teacher-preferred pairs score 6 to 10 LC points below the full procedure, whereas varying the number of on-policy samples per prompt (1 to 7) moves the LC win rate by at most 2.1 points, and a margin sweep (1 to 5) run in its own pipeline by at most 2.4 points. We also report the cost of the pipeline and where the practical algorithm departs from the theory it approximates. All results are single runs, and GPT-4o is both the teacher and the evaluation judge; we discuss what this implies for the reported gains.
blocks.zh: Direct Nash Optimation(DNO)通过近似双玩家偏好游戏的Nash均衡来将语言模型与一般偏好功能相配合. 其实用变体DNO-Prct,迭代政策采样,LLM对样本的评分加上教师的黄金应答,大边角偏好派选择和DPO风格的对比性更新. 我们独立地重新执行DNO-Prct,并用两个开放量级指示模型来研究它,Llama 3.1 8B Instruct和Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1,使用GPT-4o或者一个更大的开放量级模型,与注释器相同. 在以GPT-4o为评委的AlpacaEval 2.0上,三次迭代将长控(LC)对格PT-4o的胜率由拉玛的31.7%提升至45.3%,对米斯特拉尔的胜率由6.8%提升至18.4%,调制8B模型得分高于拉玛3.1 70B对每一次报道的胜率进行指示. 与同家族开放量级的注释员,运行保留了以GPT-4o作为注释员实现的LC增益的62%(Llama)和82%(Mistral),因此评级步骤不需要专有模式. 在单独的减速配置中,去除金应答,去掉数据回看的变体,或者只接受老师偏爱的对子在全程序下得分6至10LC,而改变每快(1至7)的政策样本数量将LC的胜率移动最多2.1分,在自己的输油管中进行比值扫描(1至5)最多2.4分. 我们还报告输油管的费用以及实际算法偏离其理论之处。 所有结果都是单行的,GPT-4o既是老师又是评审法官;我们讨论这对所报告的收益意味着什么.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly ( Radford et al., 2018 ; Radford et al., 2019 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Rae et al., 2021 ) . Trained only to predict the next token, they are not by themselves aligned with what humans prefer. Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Stiennon et al., 2020 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2022 ; Touvron et al., 2023 ; OpenAI, 2023 ) bridges this gap by collecting human preferences, training a reward model on them, and optimizing the policy with reinforcement learning. Single-stage contrastive methods such as Direct Preference Optimization ( Rafailov et al., 2023 , DPO;) remove the explicit reward model. In their standard formulations, both assume a pointwise (Bradley–Terry) reward and therefore cannot represent intransitive preferences, which Liu et al. (2025) show arise with high probability under a Luce-type preference model; they are also vulnerable to reward hacking ( Amodei et al., 2016 ) , and a reward model or preference dataset fixed in advance becomes stale as the policy distribution shifts during training ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Azar et al., 2024 ; Munos et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 预训大型语言模型(LLMs)已迅速进步(拉德福德等,2018;拉德福德等,2019;布朗等,2020;雷等,2021). 训练只是为了预测下个征兆,他们自己并不符合人类所喜欢的. 加强从人类反馈学习(RLHF)(Christiano等,2017年;Stiennon等,2020年;Oyang等,2022年;Bai等,2022年;Touvron等,2023年;OpenAI,2023年)通过收集人类偏好,培训奖励模式来弥补这一差距,并用强化学习来优化政策. 单相对比方法,如"直接优惠优化"(Rafailov等,2023, DPO;)去掉明确的奖励模式. 在其标准配方中,两者都假定有分寸(Bradley-Terry)的奖励,因此不能代表不便的偏好,刘等. blocks.en: To address these limitations, a line of work optimizes the general preference function directly by finding the Nash equilibrium of a two-player game, solving that game with single-player (self-play) algorithms that exploit the symmetry of the preference function ( Munos et al., 2024 ; Swamy et al., 2024 ) . For a preference function with 𝒫 ⁡ ( y ≻ y ′ ∣ x ) + 𝒫 ⁡ ( y ′ ≻ y ∣ x ) = 1 \mathcal{P}(y\succ y^{\prime}\mid x)+\mathcal{P}(y^{\prime}\succ y\mid x)=1 and 𝒫 ( π ≻ π ′ ) := 𝔼 x ∼ ρ , y ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ x ) , y ′ ∼ π ′ ( ⋅ ∣ x ) [ 𝒫 ( y ≻ y ′ ∣ x ) ] \mathcal{P}(\pi\succ\pi^{\prime}):=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\rho,\,y\sim\pi(\cdot\mid x),\,y^{\prime}\sim\pi^{\prime}(\cdot\mid x)}[\mathcal{P}(y\succ y^{\prime}\mid x)] for a prompt distribution ρ \rho , a Nash equilibrium is a policy π ⋆ \pi^{\star} with 𝒫 ⁡ ( π ⋆ ≻ π ) ≥ 1 2 \mathcal{P}(\pi^{\star}\succ\pi)\geq\tfrac{1}{2} for every competing policy π \pi in the policy class Π \Pi ; this policy is the Minimax Winner of the game. Rosset et al. (2024) propose Direct Nash Optimization (DNO): a provable algorithm whose iterates converge to the Nash equilibrium on average, together with a practical variant, DNO-Prct, which in their largest run, on about ten times more prompts over six iterations, brought a 7B model to a 33% length-controlled AlpacaEval 2.0 win rate against GPT-4 Turbo, with GPT-4 Turbo as annotator and gold-response source. DNO-Prct bundles several design choices: batched on-policy sampling, a teacher’s gold response among the candidates, LLM-based rating against a rubric, a minimum rating margin, and a decaying look-back over earlier pairs.

blocks.en:
To our knowledge no independent re-implementation of DNO-Prct has been published: its published results, including its ablations, use one base model and a proprietary annotator, so it is not known whether its gains and design choices transfer to other base models and annotators.
This paper is an empirical study of DNO-Prct. We re-implemented the algorithm from the description in Rosset et al. (2024) , ran it on two open-weight instruct models with GPT-4o and with same-family open-weight models as annotators, and examined its main design choices. Throughout, “DNO” refers to DNO-Prct unless stated otherwise. Our contributions are as follows.

Together with Rosset et al. (2024) , this describes the pipeline in enough detail to re-implement it.

(2024, Section 5.2) compared large-margin filtering, on-policy sampling and the SPIN and DNO-Restrictive pair rules in their own setting, and their Table 2 tracks teacher- and student-preferred pairs and the average teacher and student ratings across iterations. We extend these analyses beyond that setting, to two further base models and to open-weight annotators, add sweeps of the rating margin and the number of samples, and repeat their teacher–student analysis (Section 6.5 ). The experiments were run in 2024, and Section 3 relates them to work that appeared during or after them, notably on preference leakage between data generator and judge ( Li et al., 2026 ) and on the exploitability of AlpacaEval ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: Guarantees: Each exact iteration is one step of soft policy iteration, a no-regret update, so the uniform mixture π ¯ \bar{\pi} of the iterates converges to the Nash equilibrium of the two-player preference game, the Minimax Winner ( Kreweras, 1965 ; Simpson, 1969 ; Kramer, 1973 ; Fishburn, 1984 ) ; the mixture argument is due to Swamy et al. (2024) , and Munos et al. (2024) establish last-iterate convergence for the regularized game. Rosset et al. (2024) also establish two further properties (their Section 3.1 and Theorem 1). The exact soft-policy-iteration update improves monotonically, 𝒫 ( π t + 1 ⋆ ≻ π t ) ≥ 1 2 + η 𝔼 x ∼ ρ [ D KL ( π t + 1 ⋆ ∥ π t ) ] \mathcal{P}(\pi^{\star}_{t+1}\succ\pi_{t})\geq\tfrac{1}{2}+\eta\,\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\rho}[D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi^{\star}_{t+1}\,\|\,\pi_{t})] , and their Theorem 1 bounds the expected squared total-variation distance between the learned π t + 1 \pi_{t+1} and π t + 1 ⋆ \pi^{\star}_{t+1} in terms of the sample size, the size of the policy class, a boundedness constant R max R_{\max} and a data-dependent concentrability coefficient, so the improvement carries over up to that error. These statements hold under the assumptions of the cited results (realizability of the soft-policy-iteration target in the policy class, and boundedness), and the bound is informative only when the concentrability coefficient is small; neither condition is guaranteed for a neural policy class. The improvement is against the previous iterate under 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and ρ \rho ; it is not a statement that benchmark scores rise at every iteration or that the student surpasses a fixed teacher. blocks.en: DNO-Prct: The main obstacle in practice is the expectation in Eq. ( 1 ). Rosset et al. (2024) therefore propose DNO-Prct, each iteration of which has three steps: 1. Batched on-policy sampling and rating: K K outputs per prompt are sampled from the current policy π t \pi_{t} and, together with a gold response y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} from a stronger teacher model, are scored by an annotator; the scores serve as a proxy for the pairwise win-rate ranking under 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . 2. Preference pair construction: Only pairs whose scores differ by a sufficiently large margin are kept, with the intent that the target σ ⁡ ( Δ t ⋆ ) \sigma(\Delta^{\star}_{t}) , after a rescaling of r t r_{t} , be close to one so that Eq. ( 5 ) reduces approximately to the pure contrastive (DPO) loss (an approximation discussed in Section 6.6 ); a decaying fraction of pairs from earlier iterations is mixed in (data look-back, described in Section 5.1 of Rosset et al. (2024) rather than in their Algorithm 2). 3. Contrastive update: The policy is trained with the DPO objective on the constructed pairs, with π t \pi_{t} as the reference policy. DNO-Prct is thus an iterative, on-policy form of DPO with the same contrastive objective; the difference lies in how the preference pairs are constructed (Figure 1 in Section 4.2 ). We refer readers to Rosset et al. (2024) for the derivation.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: RLHF and offline contrastive alignment: The reward-model-plus-RL recipe ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Stiennon et al., 2020 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) is a standard route to aligned chat models. Offline contrastive methods such as DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , IPO ( Azar et al., 2024 ) and SimPO ( Meng et al., 2024 ) fit the policy directly to a preference dataset; Zephyr ( Tunstall et al., 2023 ) popularized distilled supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on UltraChat followed by DPO on UltraFeedback ( Cui et al., 2024 ) . DPO and SimPO inherit the transitivity of a pointwise (Bradley–Terry) reward, which IPO avoids, and DPO in particular is known to exploit response length ( Park et al., 2024 ) . Meng et al. (2024) report that Llama-3-8B-Instruct trained with SimPO reaches 44.7% LC on the public AlpacaEval 2.0 leaderboard, above Llama-3-70B-Instruct (34.4%), so a small model scoring above a larger sibling on this metric is not by itself evidence of a better algorithm.
blocks.zh: RLHF和离线对比比对: 奖励-模范-plus-RL配方(Christiano等,2017;Stiennon等,2020;Oyang等,2022;Bai等,2022)是统一聊天模式的标准途径. 脱线对比方法,如DPO(Rafailov等,2023年),IPO(Azar等,2024年)和SimPO(Meng等,2024年)直接将政策与偏好数据集相匹配;Zepher(Tunstall等,2023年)被普及后在UltraChat上被监督的微调(SFT),再由DPO在UltraFeedback上进行(Cui等,2024年). DPO和SimPO继承了分点(Bradley-Terry)奖励的过渡性,IPO避免了这种奖励,而DPO尤其已知利用了响应长度(Park等,2024). 孟等编. (2024年)报道说,与SimPO一起训练的Llama-3-8B-Instruct在公共AlpacaEval 2.0领导板上达到44.7%的LC,高于Llama-3-70B-Instruct(34.4%),因此一个小模型在这个度量标准上方的比比较大的一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一比一好.

blocks.en: Iterative, online and self-play alignment: Iterative DPO ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2024 ) , online AI feedback ( Guo et al., 2024 ) and Self-Rewarding LMs ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) regenerate preference data from the current policy each round. Tang et al. (2024) find that the advantage of online over offline alignment is not explained by data coverage or quality alone and point to on-policy sampling as the deciding factor; Lanchantin et al. (2025) find that semi-online training, in which the response generator is synchronized with the policy only every few updates, as in DNO-Prct’s per-iteration sampling, performs on par with fully online training and well above offline methods. SPIN ( Chen et al., 2024 ) treats the SFT targets as always preferred over self-generated responses. Game-theoretic methods seek the Nash equilibrium of the preference game: Nash-MD ( Munos et al., 2024 ) , online IPO ( Calandriello et al., 2024 ) , SPO ( Swamy et al., 2024 ) , SPPO ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , INPO ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , DNO ( Rosset et al., 2024 ) and, concurrently with or after our experiments, MPO ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , optimistic online mirror descent ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and RSPO ( Tang et al., 2026 ) . REBEL ( Gao et al., 2024 ) regresses relative rewards and extends to intransitive preferences, and Zhang et al. (2025c) learn general preference models beyond Bradley–Terry for such methods. INPO reaches 42.6% LC on AlpacaEval 2.0 from a Llama-3-8B SFT model with an open-weight pairwise preference model and no proprietary model in the loop. We have not found a published independent re-implementation of DNO-Prct on other base models, nor a public implementation of it.
blocks.zh: 迭代,在线和自玩相接:迭代 DPO (徐等,2023;相克等,2024;董等,2024;在线AI回馈 (郭等,2024;自取回还 (袁等,2024;自取回还) 从当前政策中每轮重取偏好数据. Tang等人(2024年)发现,在线比离线对接的优势并不仅仅以数据覆盖或质量来解释,并指出政策抽样是决定因素;Lanchantin等人(2025年)发现,半在线培训,即响应生成器与政策同步的每少数更新,如DNO-Prct的入线抽样,与完全在线培训和离线方法完全相同。 SPIN(Chen等,2024年)将SFT目标视为总是优于自发反应. Game-theoretic方法寻求取向游戏的纳什均衡: Nash-MD (Munos等,2024年),在线IPO (Calandriello等,2024年),SPO (Swamy等,2024年),SPPO(Wu等,2025年),INPO(Zhang等,2025年b),DNO(Rosset等,2024年b),与我们的实验同时或之后的MPO(Wang等,2025年),乐观的在线镜像回落(Zhang等,2025年a)和RSPO(Tang等,2026年). REBEL(Gao等,2024年)相对回报递减并延伸至不易的偏好,而张等(2025年c)则为此类方法学习了布拉德利-特瑞以外的一般偏好模式. INPO从Llama-3-8B SFT模型中从AlpacaEval 2.0上达到42.6%的LC,具有开放式双向偏好模型,环中无专有模型. 我们尚未发现在其他基本模型上公布独立重新实施DNO-Prct,也未发现公开实施.

blocks.en: Where do the gains of AI feedback come from? Sharma et al. (2024) show that improvements attributed to reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) are largely explained by using a weaker teacher for SFT than the critic used for feedback, and that SFT directly on GPT-4 completions outperforms the pipelines they study. Our gold-response ablation (Section 6.3 ) is related but not a replication of their comparison: we did not run a matched-teacher SFT control. Ivison et al. (2024) disentangle preference data, learning algorithm, reward model and policy prompts in a comparable empirical study of DPO and PPO. Open-weight models trained specifically as evaluators can match or exceed GPT-4 on reward-model benchmarks ( Wang et al., 2024 ) ; our open-weight annotators were not evaluator-trained and retained 62–82% of the LC gain of the GPT-4o-annotated runs against GPT-4o (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: AI反馈的收获来自何处?. Sharma等人(2024年)表明,由于强化学习AI反馈(RLAIF)而导致的改进主要通过使用比评论家用来反馈的更弱的SFT老师来解释,并且直接在GPT-4上完成的SFT比他们所研究的管道表现要好. 我们的金子反应减退(第6.3节)是相关联的,但并不是对它们的比较的复制:我们没有进行匹配教师的SFT控制。 伊维森等. (2024)分解偏好数据,学习算法,奖励模型和政策提示,对DPO和PPO进行比较经验研究. 由于评估人员在奖励模式基准上可以匹配或超过GPT-4(Wang等,2024年)而接受过专门培训的开放量模型;我们的开放量模型没有经过评估人员的培训,保留了GPT-4附加说明的LC对GPT-4o的62-82%的收益(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation and its failure modes: We evaluate with AlpacaEval 2.0 ( Li et al., 2023 ) and its length-controlled win rate ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) , which with the default judge and reference correlates strongly with the rankings of Chatbot Arena ( Chiang et al., 2024 ) ; our judge and references are not the default (Section 4.1 ). LLM judges exhibit position, verbosity and self-preference biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Wataoka et al., 2024 ) . Li et al. (2026) find that a judge favors students trained on data from a related model: their average preference-leakage score is about 24% when judge and data generator are the same model, as GPT-4o is in our main runs, and about 3–9% when they share a model family. Zheng et al. (2025) show that a null model that always returns the same, adversarially crafted response reaches 86.5% LC on AlpacaEval 2.0. Both appeared during or after our experiments, and Section 8 uses them to interpret our results.
blocks.zh: LLM-as-a-judge评价及其失败模式: 我们与AlpacaEval 2.0(Li等,2023年)及其长度控制的取胜率(Dubois等,2024年)进行了评价,这与缺省裁判和参考文献与Chatbot Arena(Chiang等,2024年)的排名密切相关;我们的裁判和参考文献不是缺省(第4.1节)。 LLM评委展示立场,动词和自取偏好(郑等,2023;Panickssery等,2024;Wataoka等,2024). Li等人(2026年)发现,一名法官喜欢接受过相关模型数据培训的学生:当法官和数据生成器是同一模型时,他们的平均偏好漏分约为24%,因为GPT-4o在我们的主要运行中,而当他们共享模型家庭时,他们的平均偏好漏分约为3-9%. Zheng等 (2025)显示,一个总是返回同样,对抗性地精心设计的反应的无效模型在阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔2.0上达到了86.5%的LC. 两者都在我们的实验期间或之后出现,第8节用它们来解释我们的结果.

blocks.en: 3.1 Relation to Online DPO
blocks.zh: 3.1 与在线DPO的关系

blocks.en: DNO is conceptually close to online DPO ( Guo et al., 2024 ) . In each round of online DPO the model generates two candidate responses to a prompt, an annotator decides which is better, and the resulting pair is used for a DPO-style update. DNO likewise samples candidates, rates them and learns from the resulting preferences, but differs in three ways.
blocks.zh: DNO在概念上接近于在线DPO(Guo等,2024. 在每轮的在线 DPO 中, 模型生成两个候选人对一个快速的响应, 一个注释员决定哪个更好, DNO同样对考生进行抽样,评分,从由此产生的偏好中学习,但有三种不同.

blocks.en: (1) Rating guideline and margin: DNO rates responses against an explicit rubric and forms a pair only when the positive–negative rating margin is sufficiently large. The margin filter is what allows the regression objective of Eq. ( 5 ) to be approximated by the pure contrastive loss without an excessively large KL coefficient ( Rosset et al., 2024 , Section 4) ; it is an approximation device rather than a condition for Nash convergence. Its empirical effect is studied in Section 6.2 .
blocks.zh: (1) 评分准则和比值:DNO对一分明的分数的响应,只有在正负分数比值足够大时才能形成一对. 比值滤波器是允许Eq. (5) 的回归目标被纯对比性损失相近而无过大的KL系数(Rosset等, 2024, 第4节) ;它是近似装置,而不是纳什趋同的一个条件. 第6.2节研究了其经验效应。

blocks.en: (2) Multiple on-policy candidates: Instead of a single pair per prompt, DNO samples K K candidates per prompt, intended to cover more of the policy’s output distribution than a single pair. Section 6.1 varies K K .
blocks.zh: (2) 多个政策候选人: DNO不是每快一对,而是每快一对K候选人的样本,意在覆盖政策的产出分配,而不是一对。 第6.1节K不同。

blocks.en: (3) Teacher responses as candidates: DNO adds the teacher’s response y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} to the candidate set. Rating teacher and student responses together captures cases where the student outperforms the teacher, which SPIN-style self-play ignores (Sections 6.3 and 6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 对教师和学生的回应进行评分,可以捕捉学生表现优于教师的情况,而SPIN式的自玩忽视了这种情况(第6.3和6.4节)。

blocks.en: Online DPO as instantiated by Guo et al. (2024) additionally keeps a fixed reference policy and samples pairs per mini-batch, whereas DNO-Prct collects a large batch per iteration, resets the reference to π t \pi_{t} , and mixes in look-back data.
blocks.zh: 由郭等(2024年)即时化的在线DPO额外保留了固定的参考政策和每只小批量取出一对样本,而DNO-Prct每次重复收集一大批,重放参考Qπ t\pi_{t},并混合回放数据.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 General Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 一般设置

blocks.en: Timeline: All experiments were run between the release of Llama 3.1 and Mistral Large 2 in late July 2024 and the end of December 2024, with the model and API versions available then. All reported results come from these 2024 runs; a few descriptive statistics, such as the prompt overlap and the truncation rate, were computed afterwards from their stored outputs.
blocks.zh: 时间线 : 所有实验都是在2024年7月下旬Llama 3.1和Mistral Large 2的发布到2024年12月底之间运行,模型和API版本当时可供使用. 所有报告的结果都来自这2024年的运行;随后从其储存的产出中计算出一些描述性统计数字,如即时重叠和截取率。

blocks.en: Dataset: We use the UltraFeedback dataset ( Cui et al., 2024 ; OpenBMB, 2023 ) as the fine-tuning and preference-alignment dataset. UltraFeedback comprises 63,967 prompts, four responses per prompt from a pool of seventeen models (including GPT-4, GPT-3.5 Turbo, Bard, Llama-2-70B-chat, Vicuna-33B and Falcon-40B-Instruct), and GPT-4 annotations along four aspects (instruction following, truthfulness, honesty and helpfulness), each on a 1–5 scale, together with an overall score on a 1–10 scale. The prompts are sourced from UltraChat, ShareGPT, Evol-Instruct, TruthfulQA, FalseQA and FLAN. The SFT and offline-DPO thresholds below are applied to the average of the four per-aspect ratings. In addition to the original content, we generate one response from GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) for every prompt to serve as the gold response y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} in the GPT-4o-annotated runs.
blocks.zh: 数据集:我们使用UltraFeedback数据集(Cui等,2024;OpenBMB,2023)作为微调和偏好调整数据集. UltraFeedback包含63,967个提示,从17个模式(包括GPT-4,GPT-3.5 Turbo,Bard,Llama-2-70B-chat,Vicuna-33B和Falcon-40B-Instruct)的集合中,每个提示中有4个响应,以及GPT-4四个方面(指令遵循,诚实,诚实和有帮助),每个响应1到5个比例,加上1到10个比例的总分. 提示来源于UltraChat, ShareGPT, Evol-Instruct, TruthfulQA, FalseQA和FLAN. 以下SFT和下线-DPO阈值适用于每方四个评级的平均值. 除了原始内容, 我们从GPT-4o(OpenAI, 2024)中生成一个响应, 用于在GPT-4o-附加说明的跑道中,

blocks.en: Base models and annotators: We experiment with two base models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1. The base model provides the initial weights for every run except the two-stage runs of Section 5.5 and the look-back ablation of Section 6.4 , which start from an SFT checkpoint. GPT-4o is the annotator in the DNO experiments except those of Section 5.4 , where the annotator is Llama 3.1 70B Instruct or Mistral Large 2 ( Mistral AI, 2024 , Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407, 123B parameters; hereafter Mistral Large;) .
blocks.zh: 基本模型和注释器: 我们用两个基础模型进行实验,Llama 3.1 8B 指令和Mistral 7B 指令v0.1. 基准型号提供每次跑道的初始权重,但第5.5节的两相跑道和从SFT检查站开始的6.4节的回放. GPT-4o是DNO实验中除第5.4节外的注释者,该节的注释者为Llama 3.1 70B Istruct或Mistral Large 2 (Mistral AI, 2024;Mistral-Large-Istruct-2407,123B参数;以下简称Mistral Large;).

blocks.en: Baselines: We compare DNO with our own implementations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), offline DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , a SPIN-style baseline ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , DNO-Restrictive, SPPO ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and online DPO ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2024 ) . Our SPIN-style baseline marks the teacher’s gold response as always preferred over the on-policy samples, which is the “mark the teacher ( T T ) always positive” rule of Section 6.4 ; it is not the original SPIN recipe, which uses the SFT targets as winners. DNO-Restrictive accepts only pairs whose positive is the teacher’s response. SPPO and online DPO were run on UltraFeedback with only the learning-rate search described below; both ended below the base model, and we therefore draw no conclusions about those methods from our runs.
blocks.zh: 基线: 我们比较DNO与我们自己实施的有监督的微调(SFT),离线DPO(Rafailov等,2023年),SPIN式基线(Chen等,2024年),DNO-限制性,SPPO(Wu等,2025年)和在线DPO(Guo等,2024年;Dong等,2024年). 我们的SPIN式基线标志了教师的金色反应,这始终比政策样本更受欢迎,政策样本是第6.4节的“标出教师(T T T ) ” 规则;不是最初的SPIN配方,而是将SFT目标作为赢家。 DNO-限制性只接受对子, SPPO和在线DPO在UltraFeed背上运行,只有以下描述的学习率搜索;两者都结束于基础模型之下,因此我们没有从我们的运行中得出这些方法的结论.

blocks.en: Pre-processing per algorithm: For SFT, we keep as targets the UltraFeedback responses whose average rating is five, the maximum, forming a question-answering dataset in OpenAI’s conversation format with the “user” role for the prompt and the “assistant” role for the response. For offline DPO, we mark responses with an average rating of five as positive and responses rated at least two points lower as negative, and collect all positive–negative pairs per prompt; the prompt takes the “user” role followed by a generation token, and each chosen or rejected response is followed by an end-of-sequence or end-of-turn token. DNO uses only the prompts and the gold responses; on-policy responses are generated on the fly. We split the prompts into three disjoint partitions, one per DNO iteration, so that no prompt is used for new candidate generation in more than one iteration; pairs built in earlier iterations may be replayed through look-back (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 每个算法的预处理 : 对SFT来说,我们把UltraFeedback反应作为目标,其平均评分为5分,最高,用OpenAI的谈话格式组成一个问答数据集,由“用户”担任即时角色和回答的“助手”角色。 对于离线DPO,我们将平均评分为5的回复标为正数,并将至少2分评为负数的回复标为正数,并收集出所有正数-负数对每快数;即时数取出"用户"角色后再取出一代代号,每选取或拒绝的回复后再取出一个序列结束或倒数. DNO只使用提示和黄金响应;在苍蝇上生成了政策响应. 我们把提示分作三段,每个 DNO 迭代一个,这样在不止一个迭代中不会对新的候选代使用提示;在更早的迭代中所建的对子可以通过回放来重放(第4.2节).

blocks.en: Training setup: We follow most hyperparameters of the Llama recipes ( Meta AI, 2024 ) . The batch size is 2 per device with 4 gradient-accumulation steps on four NVIDIA A100-SXM 80 GB GPUs, an effective batch size of 32 for all experiments, and training uses low-rank adaptation ( Hu et al., 2022 , LoRA;) (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , dropout 0.05; Appendix B ). We train SFT for 20 epochs (reporting the epoch-3 and epoch-10 checkpoints), DPO for 3 epochs, and DNO for three iterations, each a single epoch over that iteration’s training pairs, to limit overfitting to them. Each iteration consists of on-policy generation, rating, large-margin pair selection and the contrastive update with the DPO loss ( β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 ). It starts from the merged checkpoint of the previous iteration, and the reference policy is that checkpoint with the adapters disabled, i.e., π t \pi_{t} , as DNO-Prct prescribes. All algorithms are implemented with the Hugging Face TRL library ( von Werra et al., 2020 ) . All runs use seed 2024.
blocks.zh: 培训设置: 我们遵循大多数Llama食谱的超参数(Meta AI,2024年). 批量尺寸为每装置2个,在4个NVIDIA A100-SXM 80 GB GPU上有4个梯度积分步骤,所有实验的有效批量尺寸为32个,培训采用低级适应(Hu等,2022年;LORA;) (排名16,α=32\α=32,辍学;附录B.). 我们为20个纪元(报告纪元-3和纪元-10检查站),3个纪元(DPO),3个纪元(DNO),3个纪元(DNO),每个纪元都超过该纪元的训练对,以限制过于适应。 每个迭代包含政策生成,评级,大边框对选择和与 DPO 损失的对比更新(β = 0.1\β=0.1). 它从前次重复的合并检查站开始,参考政策是:与适配器一起的检查站被禁用,即按DNO-Prct的规定被禁用. 所有算法都由Hugging Face TRL库(von Werra等,2020年)实施. 所有跑道均使用2024种子.

blocks.en: Learning rate: We search over { 5 × 10 − 5 , 5 × 10 − 6 } \{5\times 10^{-5},5\times 10^{-6}\} during the first epoch (first iteration for DNO) of every experiment and keep the better rate for the remaining epochs or iterations; the rate is 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for SFT and 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for DPO and most DNO experiments. The two rates differed by 5 to 10 points in win rate against GPT-4-0613, so in our runs the choice of learning rate had a large effect.
blocks.zh: 学习率: 我们在每次实验的第一个阶段(DNO的首次重复)搜索了 { 5 × 10 − 5 , 5 × 10 − 6 }, 5 × 10 → 6 } 10 → 6 } , 并且为 DPO 和 大多数 DNO 的实验, 保持 5 × 10 − 5 = 5 = 5 = 10 = 5 = 5 = = 5 = = 5 = = 10 = = 6 = = = 5 = = = 10 = = 6 = = = = DPO 和 大多数 DNO 实验。 这两个比率与GPT-4-0613的胜出率相差5至10分,因此在我们运行中,学习率的选择产生了很大的影响.

blocks.en: Evaluation: One objective of this study is to see how far a small model can be pushed relative to a larger model of its family, so we evaluate all models, including the larger ones, under one pipeline: AlpacaEval 2.0 ( Li et al., 2023 , v0.6.5;) on its 805 prompts, reporting the raw and the length-controlled (LC) win rate ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) . The protocol departs from the public leaderboard in three ways. (i) Opponents: instead of gpt4_1106_preview , every model is compared with two opponents, GPT-4o and GPT-4-0613, whose reference outputs we generated through Azure OpenAI (temperature 0, at most 4,096 tokens). (ii) Judge: the judge is GPT-4o, prompted with AlpacaEval’s alpaca_eval_gpt4 pairwise-ranking template at temperature 0, rather than the leaderboard’s default GPT-4 Turbo annotator; GPT-4o is therefore also the teacher and one of the opponents (Section 8 ). (iii) Decoding: each evaluated model answers with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , its chat template, temperature 0.001 and at most 4,096 new tokens. AlpacaEval computes the length-controlled win rate relative to whichever reference outputs it is given, so LC values are defined for both opponents, but neither LC nor raw values are comparable to the public leaderboard or to numbers in other papers, and the reported correlation of LC with Chatbot Arena (Spearman 0.98; Dubois et al., 2024 ) was established for the default judge and reference, not for this protocol.
blocks.zh: 评价: 这项研究的目标之一是研究相对于一个更大的家庭模型,一个小模型可以推到多大的地步,因此,我们评价所有模型,包括更大的模型,在一个管道下: AlpacaEval 2.0 (Li等, 2023., v. 6.5;)在其805个提示上,报告生和长控(LC)取胜率(Dubois等, 2024.). 协议在三个方面脱离了公共领导板. (一)反对者:而不是gpt4_1106_preview,每个模型都与两个反对者GPT-4o和GPT-4-0613作比较,我们通过Azure OpenAI(温度为0,最多为4,096个令牌)生成他们的参考输出. (二) 法官:法官是GPT-4o,由AlpacaEval的alpaca-eval-gpt4在0温度下双向排列的模板所激发,而不是领导板默认的GPT-4涡轮标注;因此,GPT-4o也是教师,也是反对者之一(第8节)。 (三)解码:每个被评价的模型答案有vLLM(Kwon等,2023年),其聊天模板,温度0.001,最多4,096个新符. AlpacaEval计算相对于它给出的参考输出的长度控制赢率,因此LC值对两个对手都有定义,但LC值和原始值都无法与公共领导板或其他文件中的数字相媲美,LC与Chatbot Arena(Spearman 0.98; Dubois等, 2024年)的上报相关性是为默认裁判和参考,而不是为本协议而确定的.

blocks.en: Uncertainty: The standard error of the raw win rate reported by AlpacaEval is at most 1.9 points per evaluation (1.76 for the Llama Iteration-3 model against GPT-4o). Its standard error for the LC win rate (at most 0.26) is an error of the regression fit, not a sampling error, so we do not use it to compare models. These are evaluation uncertainties for single models; a comparison between two models on the shared prompts would need a paired analysis, which we have not done, and where we relate a difference to standard errors we treat the two evaluations as independent. The variation between training runs is unknown, because each configuration was trained once. We therefore read differences of a few points between reported runs as suggestive rather than established, and we do not claim that two configurations are equivalent when their scores are close.
blocks.zh: 不确定性:阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔报告的生取胜率的标准误差为每次评价最多1.9分(Llama迭代-3模型对GPT-4o). 其LC胜率的标准出错(最多为0.26)是回归适中的错误,不是采样出错,因此我们不使用它来比较模型. 这些是单一模型的评价不确定性;对关于共同提示的两个模型进行比较将需要进行对等分析,而我们还没有做这种分析,如果与标准错误有区别,我们将这两种评价视为独立。 培训运行之间的差别不详,因为每个配置都受过一次培训。 因此,我们把所报告的各点之间的差异看成是暗示性的,而不是确定的,我们并不认为两个组合在得分接近时是等同的。

blocks.en: On-policy response generation: At the start of each iteration we sample K = 5 K=5 responses per prompt (varied in Section 6.1 ) from the current model, the initial checkpoint in the first iteration and the model from the previous iteration thereafter, with temperature 0.7 and nucleus sampling ( Holtzman et al., 2020 , top- p p , p = 0.95 p=0.95 ;) .

blocks.en: Rating: For the K + 1 K+1 responses per prompt ( K K on-policy responses and y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} ; six in the main runs), the teacher rates quality following the preference-ranking approach of Rosset et al. (2024) , with an additive rubric of six criteria whose integer scores range from 0 to 6 (Appendix A ). Our prompt modifies the original, which was written for GPT-family annotators, so that it also works with Mistral Large and Llama 3.1 70B Instruct. Each response is evaluated along dimensions such as relevance, correctness and conciseness. For each prompt all candidates are sent to the annotator in one query, in a fixed order with y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} last, and scored side by side; the annotator returns one score per candidate. Candidates containing certain degenerate character sequences are dropped before rating, and a reply that cannot be parsed or does not contain one score per candidate is discarded.
blocks.zh: 评分:对于K+1 K+1的每分速答(KK在政策上的回应和y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}};主跑中为6分),教师按照Rosset等的偏好等级方法(2024分)评分质量,其分数从0到6分(附录A.)的分数为6分的添加分数. 我们迅速修改了原作,该作是为GPT-family的注释者所写的,因此它也与Mistral Large和Llama 3.1 70B Instruct合作. 每一份答复都按照相关性、正确性和简明性等层面进行评价。 对于每个提示,所有候选人都会在一个查询中被发送到注释者,以固定的顺序与y goldy y^{\mathrm{gold}}}最后一个,并肩得分;注释者返回每个候选人一个分. 包含某些退化人物序列的候选人在评分前被放弃,无法解析或没有包含每个候选人一个分数的回复被丢弃.

blocks.en: Preference pair construction: We select pairs ( x , y + , y − ) (x,y^{+},y^{-}) whose rating margin rating ⁡ ( y + ) − rating ⁡ ( y − ) \mathrm{rating}(y^{+})-\mathrm{rating}(y^{-}) is sufficiently large. We mark all responses with a score of at least five as positives. For each positive, responses rated at least two points lower are negatives, and we form all positive–negative pairs. If the positive is from the student and the negative is the teacher’s response, we relax the margin to one point, because GPT-4o tends to rate its own responses highly ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Wataoka et al., 2024 ) ; whether such a gap reflects judge bias or a real quality difference cannot be determined from the scores alone ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . This is a deviation from Rosset et al. (2024) , who relax the margin whenever the positive is from the student, including S ≻ S S\succ S pairs, on the grounds that their teacher’s responses rarely scored below five. Following the original paper, we include part of the data from past iterations to preserve earlier preference behavior ( data look-back ): at iteration t t we sample at most 30% of the training pairs of iteration t − 1 t-1 , 15% of those of iteration t − 2 t-2 , and so on. These pairs are reused as they are, without re-rating. Appendix C gives the procedure as pseudo-code.
blocks.zh: 首选配对构建 : 我们选择对等(x,y +,y → (x,y^{+},y^{-)),其评分比值为QQ (y +)- 评分为QQ (y−-)\mathrm{rating}(y^{+}-)-\mathrm{lating}(y^{-)足够大. 我们把至少5分的所有答复标为正数。 对于每个阳性反应,评分至少低两分的反应都是负数,我们形成所有正负对. 如果阳性来自学生,而阴性是老师的反应,那么我们把比值放宽到一分,因为GPT-4o往往会把自己的反应评为高(Panickssery等,2024;Wataoka等,2024;这种差距是反映了法官的偏差,还是真正的质量差异不能单靠分数来确定(Chen等,2025). 这是与Rosset等人(2024年)的偏差,他们只要是学生的阳性就放松比分,包括S-Q-S-succ S对,理由是他们的老师的回答很少得分低于5分. 在原论文后,我们包含来自过去迭代的部分数据,以保留更早的偏好行为(数据回放) : 在迭代t,我们最多抽取30%的训练对迭代t−1t-1,15%的迭代t−2t-2,等等. 这些对子按原样再用,不作再分级. 附 录 C给出的程序为伪码.

blocks.en: 5.1 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
blocks.zh: 5.1 Llama 3.1 8B 指令

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the main results with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct as the base model. DNO Iteration 3 performs best, with an LC win rate against GPT-4o that is 8.30 points above offline DPO (45.32% vs. 37.02%) and 11.59 points above SFT at epoch 3 (33.73%). SFT degrades with more epochs (24.01% at epoch 10, below the base model at 31.71%); a plausible explanation, which we have not tested with a matched-data control, is that its targets are UltraFeedback responses from 2023-era models, many of them weaker than the instruct base model. A single DNO iteration (39.01%) already scores 1.99 points above three epochs of offline DPO (37.02%), and the second (41.57%) is 4.55 points above it. Against GPT-4-0613 the three DNO iterations keep the same monotone ordering on both metrics, but offline DPO has a higher LC win rate (66.40%) than DNO Iterations 1 and 2 (61.44% and 64.87%), and it is the only model in Table 1 whose LC win rate against this opponent exceeds its raw win rate (54.12%). The baselines are also not consistently ordered: offline DPO is above SFT (epoch 3) on LC win rate against GPT-4o (37.02% vs. 33.73%) but below it on raw win rate against GPT-4-0613 (54.12% vs. 63.35%).
blocks.zh: 表1以Llama 3.1 8B为基准模型,列出主要结果。 DNO 迭代 3 表现最好,LC对GPT-4o的得分率比下线的DPO高8.30分(45.32%对37.02%),SFT高11.59分(33.73%)在前期3分. SFT以更划时代(在10号时间为24.01%,低于基准模型的31.71%)降解;一个我们没有用匹配数据控制测试的可信解释是,它的目标来自2023年时代模型的UltraFeedback响应,其中许多比指示基准模型弱. 单 DNO 迭接 (39.01%) 已经得分1.99分,高于下线 DPO 三个时代(37.02%),第二分(41.57%)则比它高4.55分. 相对于GPT-4-0613,三个DNO迭代在两个公尺上都保持相同的单酮定单,但下线的DPO的LC胜率(66.40%)高于DNO迭代1和2(61.44%和64.87%),这也是表1中唯一一个LC胜率超过其生取胜率(54.12%)的模型. 基线也并非一致订购:离线的DPO在LC对GPT-4o(37.02%对33.73%)的赢率上高于SFT(划向3),在生取率上低于GPT-4-0613(54.12%对63.35%)。

blocks.en: Responses grow longer with every DNO iteration (3,281 to 3,786 characters on average). At Iteration 3 the median is 2,796 characters, and about 5% of the responses reach or nearly reach the 4,096-token generation limit, so the average is raised by a small share of very long outputs, some of them truncated. The contrastive objective can widen the margin between positive and negative responses by lengthening outputs ( Park et al., 2024 ) , iterative DPO with preferences labeled by a trained reward model increases verbosity ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and Rosset et al. (2024, Section 5.2) report a length increase of at least a factor of two in their own DNO runs. Because our rating step has no explicit length control, part of the raw-win-rate gain may be due to length. The LC win rate also rises with every iteration. This is consistent with more informative responses but does not establish it, because length control is a regression adjustment. For Mistral the length growth is far larger (Section 5.2 ); we return to length in Section 8 .
blocks.zh: 答复时间随着每次DNO迭代(平均为3,281到3,786个字符)而延长. 在迭代3中,中位数为2,796个字符,大约5%的响应达到或接近4,096个托肯生成极限,因此平均值由很小一部分非常长的输出提高,有的被截断. 对比性目标可以通过延长输出(Park等,2024年),以训练有素的奖励模式为标签的特长迭代DPO来扩大正反反应的幅度(Liu等,2024年),而Rosset等(2024年,第5.2节)则报告说,他们自己的DNO运行长度至少增加了两个系数. 因为我们的评级步骤没有明确的长度控制,部分生赢率收益可能是由于长度. LC的得分率也随每次迭代而上升. 这符合更翔实的答复,但并未确立,因为长度控制是一种回归调整. 对Mistral来说,长度增长要大得多(第5.2节);我们在第8节中恢复长度。

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the comparison with Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1. The raw win rates that Rosset et al. (2024) report for their Mistral-based run are listed alongside for reference, but they are not comparable with ours: they were measured against GPT-4 Turbo with a GPT-4 Turbo annotator, starting from Orca-2.5, an SFT variant of Mistral 7B. Their Iteration 3, offline DPO and SFT-on-positives values are from their Table 1, where the baselines are reported at epoch 4; the values for Iterations 1 and 2, which their tables do not list, are approximate. As with Llama 3.1, the LC win rate against GPT-4o rises with every iteration, and Iteration 3 scores above offline DPO by 11.39 points and above SFT by 13.07 points in LC win rate against GPT-4o (18.44% vs. 7.05% and 5.37%), an 11.67-point gain over the base model. Against GPT-4-0613, both metrics decline slightly after Iteration 2 (LC 38.67% to 38.20%; raw 40.17% to 37.85%), whereas against GPT-4o they keep rising; whether this is saturation or run noise cannot be determined from single runs. One untested hypothesis is that the GPT-4o gold responses pull the student toward GPT-4o-like outputs, which the judge may score differently when the opponent is GPT-4o itself than when it is GPT-4-0613. The average response length grows to 7,506 characters, more than five times the base model’s.

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with Larger Models of the Same Family
blocks.zh: 5.3 与大家庭模式的比较

blocks.en: To probe the limits of the student, we compare each DNO-tuned model with a larger model from the same family and release period, evaluated under the identical pipeline: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct and Mixtral 8x7B Instruct v0.1, respectively. In Table 1 , Llama 3.1 8B Instruct after three DNO iterations scores above its 70B variant, which has nearly nine times as many parameters, on all four metrics; against GPT-4-0613 the LC difference is 14.95 points (70.18% vs. 55.23%), and against GPT-4o it is 3.92 points (45.32% vs. 41.40%). The raw win rates against GPT-4o differ by 8.32 points (48.26% vs. 39.94%, standard errors 1.76 and 1.72), about 3.4 standard errors of the difference between two independent evaluations. Two qualifications apply: the two models were not compared head-to-head but each against the same opponents; and GPT-4o, which produced the gold responses and rated every candidate, is also one of those opponents and the judge. The GPT-4-0613 column uses an opponent from an earlier model generation, but the judge is still GPT-4o, so it does not remove this exposure. Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1 with DNO (Iteration 3) comes close to Mixtral 8x7B on raw win rate against GPT-4o (18.53% vs. 18.76%) but remains behind on LC win rate against GPT-4o (18.44% vs. 23.09%) and on both metrics against GPT-4-0613 (38.20% vs. 41.78% LC; 37.85% vs. 50.68% raw). Mixtral has roughly 6.5 times the total parameters of the 7B model (46.7B vs. 7.2B; 12.9B active per token) in a mixture-of-experts architecture; whether that, the base model’s capacity, or the data accounts for the remaining gap we cannot tell from these runs.

blocks.en: The left and middle blocks of Table 3 compare the two annotators for Llama. Raw win rates against GPT-4o are similar (47.45% with the Llama annotator vs. 48.26% with GPT-4o), while the LC win rate is 5.19 points lower (40.13% vs. 45.32%); against GPT-4-0613 the LC gap is 11.27 points (58.91% vs. 70.18%), which may reflect more accurate ratings from GPT-4o or a judge preference for GPT-4o-like outputs (Section 8 ). blocks.en: With Mistral Large as teacher (middle block of Table 4 ), the student improves over the base model: the LC win rate rises from 6.77% to 16.30% against GPT-4o (9.5 of the 11.7 points gained with GPT-4o as annotator, 82%) and from 18.40% to 38.71% against GPT-4-0613, matching the GPT-4o-annotated run on that metric (38.20%; 0.5 points higher). Unlike the GPT-4o-annotated runs, the LC win rate against GPT-4o reaches its highest value in the first iteration (16.40%) and does not exceed it afterwards (14.29% and 16.30%), and against GPT-4-0613 it stays between 38.71% and 39.16%; response length varies widely across iterations (8,264, 5,365 and 7,699 characters). On inspection, the annotations from Mistral Large were less consistent in formatting than those of GPT-4o or Llama 3.1 70B Instruct; we have not quantified the rating-failure rate or the number of usable pairs per iteration, so we do not attribute the flat trajectory to a specific cause.

blocks.en: 5.5 Two-Stage Training: SFT Followed by DNO
blocks.zh: 5.5 双层培训:SFT 随后是DNO

blocks.en: To compare with the conventional two-stage recipe ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Tunstall et al., 2023 ) , we first fine-tune each base model with SFT and then apply DNO on UltraFeedback, with the pre-processing of Section 4.1 ; DNO then starts from the SFT checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 与传统两相配方(欧阳等,2022;通斯特尔等,2023)相提并论,我们首先用SFT来微调每个基型,再将DNO应用到UltraFeedback上,进行4.1节预处理;DNO从SFT检查站开始.

blocks.en: The right-hand blocks of Tables 3 and 4 compare two-stage training with direct DNO on the instruct model. For Llama the two recipes end close to each other in LC win rate (44.92% vs. 45.32% against GPT-4o; 68.96% vs. 70.18% against GPT-4-0613), while direct DNO keeps a lead in raw win rate (3.1 and 5.3 points). These comparisons use the canonical run of Table 1 ; the two-stage runs were trained in the configuration of the ablation reference of Table 7 (43.90% and 69.46%), against which two-stage training is 1.0 point higher on LC win rate against GPT-4o and 0.5 points lower against GPT-4-0613. Two-stage responses are shorter than direct DNO’s in the first two iterations (2,092 and 2,285 vs. 3,281 and 3,626 characters) but longer at Iteration 3 (4,342 vs. 3,786); in both recipes the LC win rate peaks at the third iteration. For Mistral the conclusion does not transfer: two-stage training has lower point estimates on all four metrics (LC 12.58% vs. 18.44% against GPT-4o and 30.56% vs. 38.20% against GPT-4-0613; raw 13.29% vs. 18.53% and 37.27% vs. 37.85%), and its responses are about 73% shorter at Iteration 3 (2,030 vs. 7,506 characters). The SFT stage is a plausible cause: the epoch-3 SFT checkpoint lowers Mistral’s LC win rate against GPT-4-0613 by 3.6 points (14.76% vs. 18.40% in Table 2 ; by 1.4 points against GPT-4o). We have not tested this explanation with a different SFT initialization.
blocks.zh: 表3和表4的右手块将两个阶段的培训与指示模型的直接DNO进行比较。 对Llama来说,两种食谱在LC取胜率(44.92%对45.32%对GPT-4o;68.96%对70.18%对GPT-4-0613)中相去甚远,而直接DNO则保持了生取胜率的领先(3.1分和5.3分). 这些比较使用表1的克通跑;两阶段的分跑在表7(43.90%和69.46%)的通缩参考配置方面得到了培训,相对LC的中和率而言,两阶段的分跑比GPT-4-0613高出1.0分,比GPT-4-0613低0.5分。 两相响应比前两相重复(2,092和2,285对3,281和3,626个字符)的DNO直接响应要短,但在第三相重复(4,342对3,786个字符)时则更长;在这两种配方中,LC在第三相重复时的取胜率都达到峰值. 对于Mistral,结论不会转移:两阶段培训对所有四个度数的分数估计较低(LC 12.58%对GPT-4o的分数为18.44%,30.56%对GPT-4-0613的分数为38.20%;生于13.29%对18.53%和37.27%对37.85%),其答复在迭代3(2,030对7,506个字符)中缩短了约73%。 SFT阶段是一个合理的原因:时代-3 SFT检查站将米斯特拉尔的LC胜率比GPT-4-0613低了3.6分(表214.76%对18.40%;比GPT-4o低1.4分)。 我们没有用不同的 SFT 初始化来测试这个解释 。

blocks.en: 6 Ablation Studies and Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 研究与分析

blocks.en: All ablations use Llama 3.1 8B Instruct with GPT-4o as annotator and three iterations, in configurations separate from the canonical runs, and ablation runs are compared with runs outside their own table only where stated. The full-DNO reference row of Tables 5 and 7 (43.90% LC against GPT-4o, 5,324 characters) is a different run from the canonical run of Table 1 (45.32%, 3,786 characters). The margin sweep of Table 6 was run with its own pair-construction and training scripts and at most 2,000 training steps per iteration. Within each sweep, the hyperparameters other than the swept one are fixed, but the number and mix of selected pairs, and hence of updates, change with it, so a sweep does not isolate one factor.
blocks.zh: 所有烧伤都使用Llama 3.1 8B 以GPT-4o作为注释员和三个迭代,以与克能克跑相分离的配置,而克能克跑只在有说明的情况下与自有表外的跑作比较. 表5和表7的全DNO参考行(43.90%的LC对GPT-4o,5,324个字符)与表1的克通跑(45.32%,3,786个字符)不同. 表6的边距扫描是用自己的对接和培训脚本进行的,每次重复最多有2 000个培训步骤。 在每次扫荡中,除被扫荡外的超参数是固定的,但所选对子的数量和组合,以及因此更新的数量,随它而改变,因此扫荡不会孤立出一个因子.

blocks.en: 6.1 Number of On-Policy Samples
blocks.zh: 6.1 政策抽样数目

blocks.en: We vary the number of on-policy samples per prompt over 1, 3, 5 and 7 (Table 5 ). The LC values lie within a 2.1-point range (43.90% to 45.96%) with no trend in the number of samples, so within this range the sample count changes the LC win rate little; the main experiments use five samples, the default of Rosset et al. (2024) . Two observations hold regardless. First, the settings differ in more than the sample count: the reported number of selected pairs spans an order of magnitude (6,733 for one sample; 68,524 for five; 68,819 for seven), and with one epoch per iteration more pairs mean more updates. Second, the average ratings of positives and negatives are similar across settings (5.8–5.9 and 3.4); averages do not capture the diversity or coverage of the selected pairs, which we did not measure.
blocks.zh: 我们改变每批1、3、5和7份政策样本的数量(表5)。 LC值位于2.1分范围内(43.90%至45.96%),样本数量没有趋势,因此在这种范围内,样本计数会改变LC的得分率很小;主要实验使用5个样本,即Rosset等人的默认(2024年). 不管怎么说,有两项观察仍然有效。 首先,设置与样本数不同:所报选定对数的相差相去相去相去相去(一个样本为6,733个;五个样本为68,524个;七个样本为68,819个),每对多一对意味着更新更多. 第二,各种环境对正反的评分平均值相近(5.8–5.9和3.4);平均值没有捕捉到所选对子的多样性或覆盖面,我们没有测量到这一点.

blocks.en: 6.2 Rating Margin
blocks.zh: 6.2 评分幅度

blocks.en: A large calibrated reward gap motivates the contrastive approximation to Eq. ( 5 ); a large rubric-score gap is only a proxy for that condition (Section 6.6 ), but a margin that is too large discards most pairs and shifts the data mix toward teacher positives. Table 6 evaluates margins of one to five with all other hyperparameters fixed; the number and mix of selected pairs, and hence of updates, change with the margin. The LC win rate against GPT-4o lies between 36.60% and 38.99% for all five margins, with the highest value at margin three; over this range the LC win rate changes by only 2.4 points, and the main experiments keep the default margin of two from Rosset et al. (2024) . Rosset et al. (2024, Section 5.2) compared margin filtering with training on all pairs and found filtering beneficial; our sweep varies the margin but has no unfiltered run. Three observations follow from the pair statistics. First, the share of pairs whose positive is the teacher’s response is about 30% at margins one and two and 35–38% at margins three to five; it is not monotonic in the margin. Second, the average rating of positives stays at 5.8–6.0 while that of negatives falls from 3.70 to 0.92, so large margins select very poor negatives. We did not measure whether such pairs are less informative per sample. Under the DPO loss the per-pair gradient weight is σ ⁡ ( − z ) \sigma(-z) , where z z is the model’s implicit log-ratio margin scaled by β \beta ; because the reference policy is the starting checkpoint of each iteration (Section 4.1 ), z = 0 z=0 for every pair at the first update with the default adapter initialization, regardless of the rubric gap, so the rubric gap does not by itself change the initial gradient weight. Third, the average response length decreases with the margin, which may partly reflect the larger share of the teacher’s typically shorter responses at margins three to five, although the share does not track length at every step. The margin also sets the data volume, from 148,764 reported selected pairs at margin one to 1,815 at margin five.

blocks.en: 6.3 Gold Responses

blocks.en: We examine the role of y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} . In addition to preference signals, DNO includes the teacher’s response as one of the candidates; in practice, gold responses may be unavailable because they cost more than preference labels alone. Removing them (row “Remove y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} ” of Table 7 ) lowers the LC win rate against GPT-4o from 43.90% to 36.97% and against GPT-4-0613 from 69.46% to 55.36%, while the raw win rates change by − - 0.9 and + + 1.9 points. The drop is consistent with the teacher’s responses being rated well above the student’s in the first iteration (Table 8 ). Without y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} , DNO becomes a bootstrapped online DPO with more than two candidates per prompt. Its LC win rate against GPT-4o (36.97%) is close to that of our offline DPO baseline (37.02% in Table 1 ); the two runs use different data and training budgets, so the proximity is not a controlled comparison. Two controls that we did not run would separate the questions this raises: (i) offline DPO under the ablation training budget, to test whether the budget explains the proximity; and (ii) offline DPO trained from the same initialization on the Iteration-1 DNO pairs, with matched update budget, pair rule, gold inclusion and prompt coverage, to test whether iterative on-policy resampling adds anything to a single round of teacher-rated data. With preference signals alone, the variant without y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} still scores 5.3 LC points above the base model (31.71%).

blocks.en: 6.4 Pair-Selection Rule and Data Look-Back
blocks.zh: 6.4 对等- 选取规则和数据后视

blocks.en: Table 7 compares the full pair-selection rule with two restricted rules. Always marking the teacher’s response as positive and all student responses as negative (the SPIN-style rule) lowers the LC win rate by 8.73 points against GPT-4o and by 19.16 points against GPT-4-0613. A plausible reason is that this rule labels a student response as negative even when the annotator rates it above the teacher’s, which becomes more frequent in later iterations (Table 8 ). Accepting only T ≻ S T\succ S pairs, i.e., trusting the teacher only when the rating confirms it (DNO-Restrictive), lands between the two against GPT-4o ( − - 5.92 vs. − - 8.73 points) and about half as far below the full rule against GPT-4-0613 ( − - 9.30 vs. − - 19.16); the full rule scores highest on both LC metrics. On raw win rate the SPIN-style rule is level with or above the full rule, while DNO-Restrictive is 3 to 4 points below; the benefit of the full rule therefore shows mainly in the length-controlled metric, and the full-DNO reference also has the longest responses in the table (5,324 characters vs. 2,489 to 4,802), so this benefit depends on the length adjustment, which we have not validated for responses this long (Section 8 ). On LC win rate our ordering, SPIN-style < < DNO-Restrictive < < full rule, matches the one Rosset et al. (2024, Table 1) report in their setting.
blocks.zh: 表7将全双选规则与两个限制性规则进行比较. 总是将老师的回答标为正面,所有学生的回答都标为负面(SPIN-tyle规则),使得LC的取胜率以8.73分对GPT-4o和19.16分对GPT-4-0613. 这一规则将学生的反应贴上负面的标签, 只接受 T QQ S T\succ S配对,即只有在评分确认(DNO-限制性)时才信任老师,在两人对GPT-4o(−- 5.92对−- 8.73分)和远低于对GPT-4-0613(−- 9.30对− 19.16)的完全规则分数之间着陆;完全规则分数在LC两个度数上最高. 在生取胜率方面,SPIN式的规则与全规则处于或高于等值,而DNO-限制性规则则低于等值;因此,全规则的好处主要表现在长度控制的度量上,而全DNO参考也拥有表中最长的响应(5,324个字符对2,489个字符对4,802个字符),因此这一好处取决于长度调整,我们还没有验证这长的响应(第8节). 在 LC 中,我们订购的 SPIN 式 < DNO- 限制性 < 完全规则, 符合 Rosset et al. (2024, 表1) 中的报告 。

blocks.en: Removing the training pairs carried over from previous iterations (row “Remove data look-back”) lowers the LC win rate by 8.90 and 19.36 points relative to the full-DNO reference, while the raw win rates are almost unchanged against GPT-4o (41.61% vs. 41.77%) and higher against GPT-4-0613 (67.45% vs. 64.21%). This variant was trained from the SFT checkpoint, so its like-for-like counterpart is the two-stage Iteration-3 run of the same run family, trained with look-back (Table 3 : 44.92% / 45.14% against GPT-4o and 68.96% / 69.30% against GPT-4-0613). Against that run, removing look-back lowers the LC win rate by 9.92 and 18.86 points and the raw win rate by 3.53 and 1.85 points, so the decline holds on all four metrics. One hypothesis is that, because candidate responses are generated on-policy, a model that no longer sees earlier pairs regresses to behaviors that were already penalized; we observed only the aggregate scores, not those behaviors.

blocks.en: 6.5 Student Evolution under the Teacher–Student Framework
blocks.zh: 6.5 教师-学生框架下的学生演变

blocks.en: We examine how the rated quality of the student’s responses evolves relative to the teacher’s, repeating on two other base models the per-iteration analysis of Rosset et al. (2024, Table 2) , who used a GPT-4 Turbo teacher. Table 8 compares teacher and student responses on length, rating and pair composition; each row describes the responses sampled at the start of that iteration, not the checkpoint at its end. The student’s average rating rises with every iteration, and so does the share of selected pairs whose positive is a student response. For Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, the student’s average rating in Iteration 1 is 3.28, 1.58 points below the teacher’s 4.86; the two averages are nearly equal in Iteration 2 (4.43 vs. 4.42, on a different prompt partition) and the student’s is 0.26 points higher in Iteration 3. By Iteration 3 there are also more S ≻ T S\succ T than T ≻ S T\succ S pairs (7,602 vs. 6,057), showing that the selection rule admits student-positive, teacher-negative pairs, as Rosset et al. (2024) also observed; this count is not a test of equilibrium attainment or teacher-level performance. Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1 shows the same trend: the student’s rating improves across iterations and its share of pairs with a student positive more than doubles, from 33.45% to 77.01%, although its rating (4.13) stays below the teacher’s (4.66) in these runs.

blocks.en: Three caveats qualify this picture. First, the comparison is made on the annotator’s own rubric: the same GPT-4o that produced y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} also scores it, and training-time rubric scores and external benchmark win rates measure different things. Under AlpacaEval the Llama Iteration-3 model wins 388, loses 416 and ties one of the 805 comparisons with GPT-4o (raw win rate 48.26%, standard error 1.76), which is not distinguishable from parity. Second, the teacher’s average rating falls across iterations (4.86 to 4.26 for Llama) even though its responses are fixed, as Rosset et al. (2024) also report for their teacher; because each iteration uses a different prompt partition and the six responses are scored side by side, we cannot separate harder prompts from relative scoring, and the change in the gap should not be read as a decomposition of student improvement versus rating drift. Third, the counts are shaped by the pair-selection rule: five student samples face one teacher response, and the one-point relaxation of the margin for S ≻ T S\succ T pairs inflates their count relative to T ≻ S T\succ S pairs. Within these caveats, the results support letting a student response serve as the positive when the annotator rates it above the teacher’s, instead of always preferring the teacher as the SPIN-style rule does (Section 6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 有三条告诫可以说明这一点。 首先,在注释员自己的标题上进行了比较:制作y goldy y mathrm{gold}的同名GPT-4o也得分,训练时间的分数和外部基准取胜率衡量不同的东西。 在阿尔帕卡-Eval下,Llama迭代-3模式胜出388分,损失了416分并链接了805个比较中与GPT-4o的一个(raw win rate 48.26%,标准出错1.76),这与平分不相分. 第二,教师的平均评分跨度(Llama的4.86至4.26),尽管其答复是固定的,因为Rosset等人(2024年)也向老师报告;因为每次评分都使用不同的即时分法,六个答复并排得分,所以我们不能把更硬的评分和相对评分分开,差距的变化不应被理解为学生的提高与评分浮动的分解. 第三,计数由对接规则所决定:5个学生标本面临1个老师回应,S QQ T S\succ的1分差被放宽. T对比起T QQ S T\succ S对来夸大计数. 在这些说明中,结果支持让学生的反应成为积极因素,当注释者将其评分高于教师时,而不是总是像SPIN式的规则那样偏爱教师(第6.4节)。

blocks.en: Rating noise: Since we use an LLM to grade responses in a batched setting, following Rosset et al. (2024) , the ratings depend on the annotator’s instruction following ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Presenting all candidates in one query relies on the annotator to score each response separately and consistently: in GPT-4o’s rating replies we observed incomplete ratings, where fewer scores are returned than candidates, and inconsistencies in the indexing of the scores; Mistral Large was less consistent still (Section 5.4 ). Such replies are discarded, so the affected prompts contribute no pairs. The candidates are presented in a fixed order with y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} last, so any position bias of the annotator ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) falls systematically on the gold response. The ratings have no explicit length control, and the student’s responses are longer than the teacher’s from the first iteration for Llama and from the second for Mistral (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 评分噪声 : 由于我们使用LLM在分批的环境下进行分级响应,按照Rosset等人(2024年),评分取决于随后的注释者指示(郑等人,2023年). 在一个查询中介绍所有候选人都依赖注释者分别和一致地对每个答复进行评分:在GPT-4o的评分答复中,我们观察到不完全的评分,评分回报比考生少,分数索引的不一致;Mistral Large仍然不太一致(第5.4节)。 这种答复被丢弃,因此受影响的提示不作对。 候选人以固定顺序排列,最后为y goldy y matmathrm{gold}}},因此注释者(郑等,2023年)的任何位置偏差都系统性地落在了黄金响应上. 收视率没有明确的长度控制,学生的回答比教师的回答要长,从Llama的第一个迭代到Mistral的第二个迭代(表8).

blocks.en: Finite on-policy samples: The on-policy sample (Step 1 of DNO-Prct) is drawn once from π t \pi_{t} at the start of the iteration, so it becomes increasingly off-policy as the update proceeds, and five samples per prompt cover only a small part of the policy’s output distribution; we did not measure their diversity.
blocks.zh: 有限的政策样本: 政策样本(DNO-Prct的第1个步骤)在迭代之初就从 \ t\pi_{t 中抽取过一次,因此随着更新的进行,它越来越失去政策性,每快5个样本只覆盖政策产出分配的一小部分;我们没有衡量它们的多样性。

blocks.en: 7 Costs of DNO
blocks.zh: 7 DNO费用

blocks.en: We report the cost of a three-iteration DNO run on UltraFeedback in terms of GPT-4o API calls and wall-clock time. By construction the pipeline makes about 2 ​ n 2n API calls for n n prompts: n n calls to generate y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} , and, because the three prompt partitions are disjoint and each prompt’s six responses are rated in one batched query, a further n n rating calls over the three iterations, before any retries. For the 63,967 UltraFeedback prompts this estimate is roughly 128,000 calls; the count recorded in 2024, approximately 126,000, is slightly lower. Failed calls are retried up to three times.
blocks.zh: 我们以GPT-4o API的电话和墙上时间来报告在UltraFeedback上运行的三进式DNO的费用。 管道通过建设, 大约2 n 2n API 调用 n 提示: n n 调用生成 y goldy y mathrm{gold}}}, 并且, 由于三个快速分区是脱节的, 用于63 967人 UltraFeedback提示这一估计大约为128,000个电话;2024年记录的计数大约为126,000个,略低. 失败的通话最多重复三次。

blocks.en: Each iteration uses one third of the prompts, for which we generate five on-policy responses each with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) ; generation takes about three to four hours on four A100 GPUs. Rating all responses takes five to six hours of API time, which multithreading reduces to about two hours. Training takes six to eight hours on the same GPUs, depending on the number of large-margin pairs. Summed over three iterations with multithreaded rating, the listed stages take 33 to 42 hours; the end-to-end time recorded in 2024 was 35 to 45 hours.
blocks.zh: 每个迭代都使用三分之一的提示,为此我们用vLLM(Kwon等,2023年)各生成出5个政策性响应;一代在4个A100GPU上需要大约3到4个小时. 对所有回复进行评分需要5至6小时API时间,而多读时间会缩短到约2小时. 培训需要6至8小时,视大边距对的数量而定。 以多条分级评分汇总出3个迭代,所列出的阶段需要33到42小时;2024年所记录的端到端时间为35到45小时.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: The teacher is also the evaluation judge and an opponent: GPT-4o generates y gold y^{\mathrm{gold}} , rates every candidate, is one of the two AlpacaEval opponents and is the AlpacaEval judge. Between 23% and 67% of the selected pairs in each iteration have a GPT-4o response as the positive (Table 8 ), the GPT-4o response is always the last candidate in the rating query, and LLM judges prefer outputs that resemble their own ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Wataoka et al., 2024 ) . Li et al. (2026) measure an average preference-leakage score of about 24% when judge and data generator are the same model, as in our main runs, and about 3–9% when they share a model family. Those magnitudes come from other settings and are not a correction for ours, but they show that part of the measured gain may be GPT-4o-likeness as scored by GPT-4o rather than better responses. The open-weight-annotator runs of Section 5.4 are a partial control only for the rating step, since the judge is unchanged: with Llama 3.1 70B Instruct as annotator the Llama student gains 8.4 LC points against GPT-4o, versus 13.6 with GPT-4o as teacher, and the difference cannot be separated into annotator quality and judge affinity. The comparison with the 70B model (Section 5.3 ) is therefore a benchmark comparison under one protocol, not a ranking. A judge outside the GPT family, an independent benchmark, matched-length analysis, and a capability-regression check on standard benchmarks are the most important additions.
blocks.zh: 这名教师也是评审裁判和一名对手:GPT-4o生成y-gold y-^{\mathrm{gold}}},评分每位候选人,是阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔的两名对手之一,也是阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔法官. 每个迭代中23%到67%的被选对子都有一个GPT-4o响应作为正数(表8),GPT-4o响应总是评分查询中最后的候选者,LLM评委偏好类似自己产出(Panikssery等,2024;Wataoka等,2024). 李等编. (2026年)当法官和数据生成者与我们的主要运行模式相同时,平均偏好漏得分约为24%,当他们共享一个模式家庭时,平均偏好漏得分约为3-9%。 这些量级来自其他环境,对我们来说并不是一个修正,但它们表明,所测量的部分收益可能是GPT-4o的GPT-4型,而不是更好的反应. 第5.4节的开放重量-注释员运行只是对评级步骤的部分控制,因为法官没有变化:与Llama 3.1 70B 作为注释员,Llama学生对GPT-4o获得8.4 LC分数,对以GPT-4o为教师的13.6分数,区别不能分割成注释员质量和判断亲和. 因此,与70B模式(第5.3节)的比较是一个协议下的基准比较,而不是排名. GPT家族外的法官,独立的基准,相匹配长的分析,以及标准基准的能力后退检查是最重要的补充.

blocks.en: Non-standard evaluation and single runs: Our evaluation protocol departs from the public leaderboard (Section 4.1 ), so our numbers are not comparable to those in other papers, and the agreement of LC win rates with human rankings has not been established for it. Every cell is a single run, and between-run variability is unknown. A verbatim search finds 13 of the 805 AlpacaEval instructions (10 of them at least 40 characters long) in the processed UltraFeedback data; because a match may fall inside a response, about 1.6% is an upper bound on exact prompt overlap, and near-duplicates were not searched. Zheng et al. (2025) show that a constant, adversarially crafted output reaches 86.5% LC on AlpacaEval 2.0; this does not show that our checkpoints exploit the benchmark, but high absolute LC values, including our 70.18% against GPT-4-0613, are evidence of preference under this judge rather than of quality in general.
blocks.zh: 非标准评价和单项运行: 我们的评价协议偏离了公共领导板(第4.1节),因此我们的人数与其他文件中的数字不相上下,而LC的赢率与人类排名的一致尚未确定。 每个细胞都是单跑,运行之间的可变性未知. 逐字搜索在已处理的UltraFeedback数据中发现了805 AlpacaEval指令中的13个(其中10个至少40个字符长);由于一个匹配可能落在一个响应中,大约1.6%是在准确的即时重叠上被上方绑定的,并且没有搜索到近复制. Zheng等人(2025年)显示,在AlpacaEval 2.0上,一个恒定的,对抗性地精心制作的输出达到86.5%的LC;这并没有显示我们的检查站利用基准,而高的绝对LC值,包括我们针对GPT-4-0613的70.18%的LC值,是在这个法官之下偏好的证据,而不是一般的质量.

blocks.en: Hyperparameter selection: The learning rate was chosen after the first epoch or iteration of each experiment. If the selection criterion was the evaluation we report, the selection is optimistic; selecting on a separate split, with the reported evaluation kept out of the selection, would remove this optimism.
blocks.zh: 超参数选择 : 学习率是在每次实验的第一个时代或迭代之后选择的. 如果选择标准是我们报告的评价,则选择是乐观的;在单独分开的情况下选择,而所报告的评价不在选择范围之外,将消除这种乐观。

blocks.en: Human preferences: No human-preference study is reported. Both the training signal and the evaluation are LLM judgments used as proxies for human preference, and the handling of intransitive preferences, the motivation for general-preference methods, was not tested.
blocks.zh: 人类喜好: 没有关于人类偏好研究的报告。 训练信号和评价都是LLM的判断,作为人类偏好取向的代名词,处理不易偏好,一般偏好方法的动机都没有经过测试.

blocks.en: Baselines: SPIN is approximated by the teacher-always-positive rule rather than by the original recipe; SFT on UltraFeedback is a weak baseline for an instruct model; our SPPO and online DPO runs received only the learning-rate search and ended below the base model, so they say nothing about those methods; and no SimPO baseline was run.
blocks.zh: 基线: SPIN与教师-始终积极的规则相近,而不是最初的食谱相近;UltraFeedback上的SFT是一个指示模型的弱基线;我们的SPPO和在线DPO运行只收到学习率搜索并结束于基模型下方,所以他们不说这些方法;没有运行SimPO基线.

blocks.en: Response length: In the direct GPT-4o-annotated runs, response length grows with iterations, to 3,786 characters for Llama and 7,506 for Mistral (Section 5 ), and the rating step has no length control. We did not measure truncation for the Mistral runs or validate the length-control regression for these unusually long responses. Length growth alone does not demonstrate reward hacking, but it is the pattern reward hacking would produce; win rates at matched length would make the claim of more informative responses testable.
blocks.zh: 响应长度 : 在GPT-4o-附加说明的直跑中,响应长度随迭代而增加,Llama的响应长度为3,786个字符,Mistral的响应长度为7,506个字符(第5节),评级步骤没有长度控制. 我们没有测量Mistral运行的断流,也没有验证这些异常长的反应的长度控制回归。 光是长度增长并不能证明对黑客的奖励,但这是对黑客的奖励将产生的模式;以相匹配的长度获得的利润率将使得更翔实的答复的说法可以检验。

blocks.en: A 2024 snapshot: The experiments were run in 2024 with the models and APIs of that time. GPT-4o is no longer a frontier judge, Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1 is superseded, and neither concurrent Nash-style methods such as INPO ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) nor evaluator-trained open-weight judges ( Wang et al., 2024 ) were compared against. We report the study because the procedural description and the design observations do not depend on the models being current; nothing has been re-run on newer models.
blocks.zh: 一个2024年的快照: 实验于2024年与当时的模型和API一起运行. GPT-4o不再担任前沿法官,Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1被取而代之,无论是INPO(Zhang等,2025年b)等并行的纳什式方法,还是经过评审培训的开放量级法官(Wang等,2024年)都没有被相提并论. 我们报告这项研究,是因为程序说明和设计观察并不取决于模型是否为当前;没有任何新的模型重新运行。

blocks.en: Algorithmic approximations: Section 6.6 lists where DNO-Prct departs from the theory it approximates; in addition, none of our experiments evaluates the uniform mixture of iterates for which the Nash guarantee holds.
blocks.zh: 算法近似:第6.6节列出了DNO-Prct偏离它所取近似理论之处;此外,我们的实验都没有评价纳什保证所持有的异步类的统一混合物.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: We re-implemented Direct Nash Optimization from its published description and studied it on two open-weight instruct models with proprietary and open-weight annotators. Under our evaluation protocol, three DNO iterations raise the length-controlled AlpacaEval 2.0 win rate against GPT-4o from 31.71% to 45.32% for Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and from 6.77% to 18.44% for Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on all four reported win rates. The rating step does not require a proprietary model: same-family open-weight annotators retain 62% and 82% of the LC gain of the GPT-4o-annotated runs against GPT-4o, and against GPT-4-0613 the Llama run retains 45% and the Mistral run matches the GPT-4o-annotated run. The ablations indicate which components matter: removing the gold responses or the look-back, or accepting only teacher-preferred pairs, scores 6 to 10 LC points below the full procedure, whereas the number of on-policy samples moves the LC win rate by at most 2.1 points and, in a separate sweep, the rating margin by at most 2.4 points. The defaults we would therefore keep are the teacher’s gold responses, look-back, and rating teacher and student responses together so that a student response can be the positive, with response length measured explicitly. These findings rest on single runs evaluated by a GPT-4o judge that is also the teacher; an independent judge, repeated runs and the matched controls of Sections 6.3 and 6.6 are the natural next steps.
blocks.zh: 我们从它公布的描述中重新应用了Direct Nash Optimization,并研究了两个有专有和开量的注释器的开量指示模型. 根据我们的评价协议,三个DNO迭代将长控的AlpacaEval 2.0取胜率从Llama 3.1 8B Instruct的31.71%提高到45.32%,将Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1的6.77%提高到18.44%,调取了比Llama 3.1 70B以上的8B模型分数. 指示所有四个报告的胜率。 评分步骤不需要专有模式:同家族开放量标注员保留了GPT-4o附加标注赛对GPT-4o的LC增益的62%和82%,而同家族开放量标注员保留了45%,而同家族开放量标注员保留了GPT-4o附加标注赛对阵GPT-4-0613. 分数表示哪些组成部分很重要:去掉金子回放或回放,或只接受老师偏爱的对分,得分低于全程的6到10个LC分数,而政策上取出样本的数量则将LC取胜率移动到最多2.1分数,并在单独打扫中将评分比分移动到最多2.4分. 因此,我们将保持的默认情况是教师的黄金反应、回望、教师和学生的回答加在一起评分,这样学生的反应就可以是正面的,并明确测量反应长度。 这些结论依赖于一名兼任教师的GPT-4o法官评估的单次运行;独立法官、重复运行以及第6.3和6.6节的相应控制是接下来的自然步骤。
